scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0133; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target examples ‘Yes. The problem is small.’ and ‘This problem is easy.’ were checked for grammar, idiomaticity, and the bounded problem sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps problem to «مشکل» within the lesson’s bounded sense and keeps prompts concise.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: A01 establishes meaning; A02 exposes the complete dialogue; A03–A06 depend only on already exposed material; A07 performs hidden retrieval; A08 is spaced story review.

distractorQuality.evidence: A03, A04, A05, and A08 use grammatical, natural distractors with explicit model contrast audits; A03 feedback is distinct for each option.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: آوا و بن در کافه درباره مشکل کوچکی در سفارش و راه‌حل ساده آن حرف می‌زنند.

difficultyFit.evidence: Only problem is a new lexical target; sentences remain short and controlled while one A1 grammar candidate is practiced.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: problem recurs across recognition, dialogue, listening, transfer, reconstruction, and hidden retrieval without adding a second unsupported sense.

transferQuality.evidence: The second exchange changes the immediate context while preserving the same bounded sense of problem.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, target construction, story, learner turns, activities, and final retrieval all point to the same lesson objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: Dependency ordering and source availability were audited, but no real learner test is claimed; perceived relevance and difficulty remain unverified.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image/photo/visual is claimed. Listening and reconstruction reference only T01–T04/T02, all marked audioRequired, and the supplying dialogue appears earlier as A02.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the specified problem sense is reviewed as new material.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text-authoring stage.
Runtime behavior is inferred from the permanent guided-dialogue/audio source contract and still requires CI/runtime validation.
